checks.requirement_case_evidence: Unique IDs, full requirement coverage, exact evidence equality, block/anchor/HTML-line references and canonical contract equality passed.
checks.future_fixture_ID_and_positive_guard: STEM-OWNED resolves; accepted source/feature, successful positive separation, independently active nonzero source/effect/wet/output and distinguishable automation are prerequisites. No audio/stem/model/reference assets supplied.

semantic_review.001_003_source_and_commands: STEM-B006-B012 support network-independent in-Live separation, mono/stereo source roles, Browser/Session/Arrangement command entry, options dialog and four element toggles. Network independence is not a real-time rendering classification or processing-speed guarantee. Universal container/codec acceptance, feature availability, private model and detected component purity remain unproven.
semantic_review.004_005_merge_and_quality_controls: STEM-B013 explicitly permits Merge for two/three versus one/four selected elements; zero and dynamic selection history remain U. No pixel value or disabled-versus-hidden presentation is invented. High Speed/High Quality are named choices only: B026-B032 model passes, SDR, CPU/GPU, elapsed-time and overlap narratives provide no architecture, benchmark, universal quality ordering or numerical output law.
semantic_review.006_transport: STEM-B015 says playback stops when separation begins. STEM-006 has a prior audible playback/input baseline and null timing oracle; start/stop deadline, recording interaction, scheduling and failure atomicity remain open.
semantic_review.007_008_output_structure_and_color: STEM-B016-B018 distinguish grouped unmerged multi-elements, one-element single track and merged single track. Source-track and dialog-toggle color relationships are nominal documentary state, not RGB/palette or Browser fallback rules. STEM-U-NONGROUP/BROWSER explicitly retain missing nongroup effect/automation destinations and source-less color as unknown.
semantic_review.009_010_source_region_and_selection: STEM-B019-B020 support audible-region and warped-loop processing roles plus the Arrangement time-selection command and split. Signal cases retain independently known before/inside/after landmarks and explicit marker/Warp/loop state. No inclusive endpoint, loop-cycle count, Warp-to-sample map, fragment activation, exact boundary or transaction oracle is fabricated.
semantic_review.011_grouped_effects_and_automation: STEM-B021 names group destination for source audio effects/track automation and stem-clip destination for clip automation/modulation. The contract restricts that predicate to grouped outputs; it asserts no single/merged destination, original-device removal, device identity, deep-copy/binding or rendered-equivalence guarantee. STEM-011 and nongroup probe require independent active nonzero effect/wet/automation baselines before no-bake/exclusion observations.
semantic_review.012_source_activation: STEM-B022 applies deactivation after successful stem creation and selected-source key0 reactivation. The case explicitly records prior active nonzero source and successful creation, with text/map focus excluded. Cancelled/failed processing and source-file rewriting remain unknown; general activation retains editing ownership.
semantic_review.013_browser_focus_and_tempo: STEM-B023 supports focus-based destination and empty-Set/sample-warp-enabled tempo role. The timing case records both prerequisites and leaves false branches, detector accuracy, empty-Set definition, tempo estimate and timing ungraded.
semantic_review.014_file_source_claim: STEM-B024 supports Current Project Stems location and individual-plus-merged file roles plus source-stated settings file type, 44100 Hz and source bit depth. STEM-014 is file kind with null documentary expected/comparator and independent source metadata prerequisite. No target header, codec, resampler, compressed/float bit-depth convention, naming/collision or output byte oracle is introduced.
semantic_review.015_Others_file_and_Set_distinction: STEM-B030 supports High Quality Others dependencies and the Vocals+Others example where only requested clips enter the Set while Drums/Bass files are retained. STEM-015 file comparator is null; this does not prescribe private pass count, subtraction arithmetic, model execution or completion time.
semantic_review.owners_cases_and_closure: Existing media/import, region/loop/split/crop/Warp, project/save, recording format, rack/host/automation/routing owners remain linked. Fourteen U probes cover output/format/boundary/repeat-mode/nongroup/Browser/fragment/undo/cancel/persistence/loss/rate/transport/teardown without inventing results. No stimuli, actual classifier output, model download or runtime execution was supplied; compound documentary clauses remain partial.
